stem: What is the key difference between plant quarantine and a pesticide restricted-entry interval?
choices: Quarantine manages biological/material movement risk, while restricted-entry is a worker-protection control tied to pesticide use and applicable requirements
They are the same control with different names
Restricted-entry applies only to visibly diseased plants
Quarantine is always a legal pesticide requirement
rationale: The controls can coexist but serve different purposes. Restricted-entry requirements are tied to pesticide worker protection; quarantine is a biosecurity/material status control.
